metadata.description: Deploy websites to simple-host.app from your coding agent — static hosting with every site at its own address (<site>.<handle>.simple-host.app), a per-site backend (KV, SQLite and file resources, each with its own read/write policy; visitor sign-in on the site's own address, separate from the owner's account sign-in; agents write with an API key), connect your own domain (subdomain or apex), and built-in visitor analytics. Personal home choice, live showcase feed, bio, pins and order.

plugins.name: simple-host
plugins.description: Describe a website and it goes online at its own address. Claude builds the site and publishes it to simple-host.app through the Simple Host connector: pages, a small per-site backend (KV, SQLite and files) with visitor sign-in for saves and sign-ups, visitor analytics, and your own domain when you want one. Choose a personal home and curate the showcase with bio, pins and order.
